| ENERGY COMBAT ~~
. 2X Energy attack costing 2 stages.

Raise your anger 1 level. Lower your opponent’s
anger 2 levels. If your MP has changed levels this
combat, search your discard pile for a Drill
and place it into play.

DAMAGE: 5 life cards.

(Banish after use.)
